text:
Throwing this out there: 

Edit: This indeed the case as confirmed by GamersNexus. Air is NOT drawn in from the back off the card. This further confirms my suspicion regarding point 2. That the barrel housing around the fan acts as a flow guide for the air. If it was open, then air would not be directed fully over the GPU and you'd end up with a really terrible and pointless blower cooler. This contrasts what is said in this video.

1) On the GamersNexus tear down at 13:01, the RX 5700 XT card looks closed off at the back end of the card as well and is not open, contrary to what is said in the video. The housing surrounding the fan looks deep enough compared to the rest of the card to be positioned against the back plate. The bar positioned behind the fan housing running the width of the card, looks solid and also positioned that it obstructs the gap in the back end of the shroud completely.
